programme.title: Forensic Files: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. The autopsy revealed that the gunshot wound was not self-inflicted, and the evidence on her body would give police a golden opportunity to catch her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Four on the Floor
programme.desc: When a Native American woman is brutally killed in the desert of New Mexico, her killers leave a crime scene rich in forensic evidence: tire tracks, shoe impressions and even the murder weapons.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writer's Block
programme.desc: A brilliant young architect falls ill and dies just before she is to testify in a criminal trial. The autopsy reveals she'd been poisoned with arsenic. Investigators must determine who had a motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clean Getaway
programme.desc: When a dry cleaner employee is raped and murdered in her store, police turn to forensic science for the answers they need.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prints Among Thieves
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected; he flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Natural Witness
programme.desc: The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Presumed Dead
programme.desc: What does it take to prove murder if the victim cannot be found? Investigators must go to extreme lengths to catch the killer when the victim is presumed dead.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Vowes
programme.desc: When lovers turn on each other, or marriages fail, some ruthless spouses find a grisly way to gain an uncontested divorce  with no paperwork. When murder tears lovers apart, forensic science must put piece together the mystery to catch the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Extreme Sex Fetishes
programme.desc: Preston is ready to ditch Jessica for cheating, but he’s the actual cheater! Then, can KB justify falling for Krystal’s god-sister even with a very open relationship?

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: One Night Stand Shockers
programme.desc: Bizarre sexual fetishes come out! Brad’s girlfriend wants him to dress like a little girl. Melissa wants her boyfriend Steve to stop his sexual fetish of flashing.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I Want To Be Dominated
programme.desc: Johnny wants his girlfriend Aimee to accept him for who he is. Then, Maya comes on the show to confront her boyfriend Eric about his tendencies.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Tales of the She-Males
programme.desc: Tony confesses to his girlfriend that he is cheating on her with a transsexual. Mary confronts her transsexual roommate Shortee. Next, Limont confronts his one-night stand.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Boxing Blowout: Viewers vs. Guests
programme.desc: In this special episode, a group of select viewers will duke it out with some of Jerry’s outrageously memorable guests!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Homewrecking Hotties
programme.desc: It's relationship drama pushed to the max today! Karla confronts her cheating ex Tom and his new girl Ashley! Hollie regrets leaving Courtney for a man and wants her back!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Trick Or Cheaters?
programme.desc: Mandy is scared stiff about losing Jesse and regrets dumping him and Johnny's relationship with Donna is at death's door because he can't stop cheating! More spooky drama today!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Cradle to the Grave
programme.desc: A frantic 9-1-1 call from a daycare reports an infant found not breathing. After a medical examination reveals signs of child abuse, Kenda must discover who committed the heinous crime.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Monster Awakes
programme.desc: When Julie Smith reports being sexually assaulted, Lt. Joe Kenda and his Sex Crimes Unit discover a terrifying similarity to other attacks on the east side of town.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: My Second Case
programme.desc: A woman’s mangled body is found beside a lonely stretch of highway. When the coroner suspects foul play, Kenda is called in to solve the second homicide case of his career.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: A Beautiful Shade of Death
programme.desc: When police discover the lifeless bodies of Sophia Gerardo, four children and a house cat, they suspect ritualistic mass murder. But Lt. Joe Kenda uncovers a reality far more frightening.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Trigger
programme.desc: A sharp-dressed pedestrian is shot in the back for unknown reasons. Chasing a promising lead, Kenda realizes he’s barking up the wrong tree.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: I Will Hunt You Down
programme.desc: When two escaped inmates surface in Colorado Springs, it’s up to Lt. Joe Kenda and his Fugitive Unit to bring them to justice.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.desc: The Shuttle Program - The first re-useable spacecraft. The Challenger Disaster - Pressing launch schedules lead to carelessness and the loss of the Challenger. Return to Space - A re-designed shuttle is back in space with a redefined role.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.desc: The Apollo Program Begins - At the very beginning of NASA's moon project things go wrong. Caves - ESA's special training program for astronauts. Planck - Mapping the cosmic microwave background radiation.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.desc: Rebuilding Project Apollo - After the Apollo 1 disaster NASA resumes manned space flight. Orbiting Carbon Observatory 2 - Monitoring the Earth's Co2 levels in unprecedented detail. Zero Gravity Training - Parabolic flights.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: Take a look at Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag! It is designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal complex and ever-changing details that are undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: From There to Here
programme.desc: The sky above is studded with stars and countless galaxies. In them, we can read not only our origin, but also our final destination. Technology is on the brink of taking us to places we have only dreamed of.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: There are many more worlds in our solar system than just the planets. The mysterious moons of the gas giants may hold much more than we ever imagined. Each one is unique, and each one deserves a scrutinous eye.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: On the Case: The Art of Murder
programme.desc: In order to solve the murder of a talented young art student, investigators must first unravel a bizarre web of jealousy and deceit.

programme.title: On the Case: Unmasking a Killer
programme.desc: A beautiful grad student is found murdered inside a yoga apparel store. On the surface it appeared she was the victim of a botched robbery, but remarkable police work revealed a far more sinister plot.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Matrimony
programme.desc: A go-go dancer told her family she needed to get away for a while and then she simply disappeared. Investigators were suspicious, because she took neither her car nor her clothes. 20 years later, her family received a call that changed everything.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muddy Waters
programme.desc: A Colorado hunter is the victim of a well-planned crime. Investigators suspect two weapons and two killers. But forensic evidence points them in a different direction — one much closer to home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Point of Origin
programme.desc: In 1984, California firefighters battled ten arson fires in three weeks. When cigarettes and a scrap of paper connected the case to similar fires further north, the hunt was on for a dangerous pyromaniac.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeds for Doubt
programme.desc: In 2002, a small community in upstate New York was devastated when Patty Wlasiuk died in a truck accident. But burdock seed pods found in her hair and on her clothes indicated that this was no accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg Up On Crime
programme.desc: The decomposed body of a young woman was discovered in a Bakersfield irrigation canal. If there was trace evidence, it had been washed away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tight-Fitting Genes
programme.desc: A behavioral profile caused the Baton Rouge Police Department to search for the wrong man. The real perpetrator may have eluded arrest, had it not been for a molecular biologist who painted DNA picture of the suspect.

programme.title: Homicide's Elite: Sins of the Family
programme.desc: When the skull of 11-year-old Alan Watson is found in a field, Quinn and Velazquez take on the case of a murder that took place almost a decade before.

programme.title: SvampeBob Firkant
programme.desc: SvampeBob Firkant, Patrick Søstjerne og alle de andre venner fra undervandsbyen Bikini Bunden er klar på masser af sjov og eventyr på kanalen, som viser den amerikanske animationsserie døgnet rundt!

programme.title: iCarly: Bukseskandalen
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon inviterer iCarly-slænget til at optræde live på sit program i New York. De elsker New York og er vildt glade for at være med i programmet, men alt kan ske i live tv.

programme.title: iCarly: Bukseskandalen (del 2)
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon inviterer iCarly-slænget til at optræde live på sit program i New York, men en stor garderobefejl fra Gibby betyder store problemer for netshowets fremtid.

programme.title: iCarly: Spencers nye venner
programme.desc: iCarly-slænget vil finde venner til Spencer på hans egen alder. De finder nogle gode muligheder, men vil venskaber blomstre?

programme.title: iCarly: Stop tyven!
programme.desc: Da Sams bærbare bliver stjålet, prøver iCarly-slænget at hjælpe hende med at opspore tyven. Imens må Spencer ikke besøge sin yndlingsspillehal, hvis han ikke er i følgeskab med et barn. Hans held vender, når Guppy har brug for en babysitter.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly takker af (del 2)
programme.desc: Carly er parat til at acceptere, at hun ikke skal med til den årlige fest, da hendes far dukker op. Hendes aften tager en uventet drejning, da hendes far stiller hende et livsforandrende spørgsmål.

programme.title: iCarly: En megafed idé
programme.desc: Da frøken Briggs nægter at lade alle Carly og Sams favoritter deltage i talentshowet, beslutter de at være værter for deres dygtige klassekammerater på deres egen onlinewebshow, iCarly.

programme.title: iCarly: Hr. Næsten Perfekt
programme.desc: Carly er lun på Jake, som går på skolen. Han er supercool og ser godt ud. Carly er vild med Jake, så hun inviterer ham til at spille guitar og synge i hendes nye webshow. Hun finder desværre ud af, at Jake er en forfærdelig sanger.

programme.title: iCarly: Kampagne-konkurrencen
programme.desc: Carly og Sam konkurrerer mod Freddie og Spencer om hvem, der kan få flest børn til at se iCarly webcast. Men det stikker helt af, da alle deres planer går grueligt galt.

programme.title: iCarly: En anmelders gunst
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie vil gerne have deres webshow anmeldt af 'Nevelocity', et superpopulært websted, der anmeldelser hjemmesider og webcasts. Da Carly skal møde Nevel finder hun ud af, at han er en irriterende dreng, der gerne vil på date med hende.

programme.title: iCarly: Ude godt, men Spencer er bedst
programme.desc: Carly og Spencers bedstefar kommer på uanmeldt besøg. Han er meget bekymret for, om Spencer er for uansvarlig og skør til at være Carlys værge. Det er op til Carly og hendes venner at overbevise hendes bedstefar om, at Spencer er en ansvarlig værge.

programme.desc: Udfor Western Capes forbløffende kyster, dramatiske bjerge og adspredte Metropolis fra flere hundrede meters højde.

programme.desc: Se Clive og Mary-Ann drikke med hedninge og søge sandheden bag en 110 meter lang figur.

programme.desc: Hvad skete der med flaget, der mærkede et af de største øjeblikke i amerikansk sport?

programme.title: Wild Germany: Forests
programme.desc: Shrouded in myth and legend, the forests of Germany and their wild inhabitants are world famous. Forests enters a world full of magic.

programme.title: The Mind of the Universe: The Explorer
programme.desc: The explorer peers beyond our known borders and discloses the unknown. We will get a glimpse of the secrets of life, both on earth and elsewhere in the universe, and zoom in on the peculiar history of our own planet. What are the borders yet to cross?

programme.title: Myth Hunters
programme.desc: California Gold Rush prospector goes in search of a legendary lost treasure ship in the Mojave Desert.

programme.title: Desert Seas
programme.desc: David Attenborough contrasts the Red Sea with the Gulf, a shallow sister sea more famous for wars and oil. Yet the Gulf is teeming with life and may even help save the wildlife of the Red Sea reef.

programme.title: Wild Baltic Sea: Between Denmark and Latvia
programme.desc: From Denmark’s northernmost corner to the endless beaches of Latvia.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Gwyneth Paltrow, Halloween Movie Snacks with Pilar Valdes, Drew's News
programme.desc: Actress Gwyneth Paltrow stops by to chat about her new Netflix reality series "Sex, Love & Goop." Then, Chef Pilar Valdes shares tasty snacks to enjoy while watching your favorite Halloween movie.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Abbi Jacobson
programme.desc: "A League of Their Own" star Abbi Jacobson opens up about her recent engagement, her bestie Ilana Glazer, what it was like co-creating, writing, producing and starring in "A League of Their Own" and more!

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Tig Notaro, Drew's News
programme.desc: "Your Place or Mine" star Tig Notaro is telling Drew about working with Reese Witherspoon on their new film and the latest season of "The Morning Show."

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Sharon Stone, Chef Carla Hall, Beauty Routines with Allure Magazine’s Editor In Chief
programme.desc: "Ratched" star Sharon Stone joins Drew. Plus, "Halloween Baking Championship" Host and Judge Carla Hall shares one of her favorite foods with Drew. Drew discusses her morning and evening routine with Allure Magazine’s Editor in Chief Michelle Lee.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Isla Fisher & Leslie Mann, Beth Behrs, Drew-Gooder
programme.desc: “Blithe Spirit's” Isla Fisher & Leslie Mann chat. ”The Neighborhood's” Beth Behrs joins Drew. Luvvie Ajayi Jones joins Drew to shine the spotlight on another amazing black woman. Meet 10 y.o. Christian Stone who cleared snow off essential workers' cars.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: David Oyelowo, Lonnie Chavis, Cooking with Joanna Garcia Swisher
programme.desc: David Oyelowo joins Drew to discuss his feature directorial debut and is joined by co-star Lonnie Chavis. Plus, “Sweet Magnolias” actress Joanna Garcia Swisher chats about her online lifestyle page The Happy Place and whips up Pickled Jalapeno Corn.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: “Queer Eye’s” Karamo Brown, Beauty In A Box, Halloween Tablescapes with Darcy Miller
programme.desc: “Queer Eye’s” Karamo Brown joins Drew. In Beauty in A Box, Drew surprises a viewer at home who is need of a quick makeup routine. Plus, celebrations expert Darcy Miller shares Halloween tablescapes to help your family celebrate the holiday this year.

programme.title: On the Case: Half Way Home
programme.desc: The discovery of a woman's body inside an abandoned trailer leads to a 28-year search for the person responsible for her beating death.

programme.title: On the Case: 22 Hours of Terror
programme.desc: A 12-year-old girl is kidnapped during a home invasion, and police frantically search for her and her abductor. Paula Zahn explores the case.

programme.title: On the Case: From Dusk to Darkness
programme.desc: After a 10-year-old girl mysteriously disappears, her family and the police undergo a tormenting journey to find a lead.

programme.title: On the Case: A Stranger Among Us
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Velda Rumfelt's disappearance in Brentwood, Missouri, in 1977 marked the beginning of a tragic, decades long mystery.

programme.title: On the Case: This is for Her
programme.desc: A deadly home invasion leaves a father of three dead. Why was the victim's wife, the only eyewitness to the crime left alive?

programme.title: On the Case: Shattered Hope
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Shelley Sikes vanishes one night after her shift, and then her abandoned, blood-streaked car is discovered on a dark roadway.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Change of Seasons
programme.desc: When her husband quits after a blowout with Joe, Kelly is put in a terrible position. Will she stay at Buffalo - or will she go? Scott gets the news he must stand down from flying so another co-pilot can fast-track to captain.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Five Seasons
programme.desc: Ice Pilots NWT celebrates a milestone with a look back at the last five years, a peek behind the camera and reflections from the Buffalo crew.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Under New Management
programme.desc: Joe hires outsider Duane Hicks to help Buffalo navigate the future and coach Mikey. Gord and Sean's DC-3 delivery mission to the High Arctic goes awry when blizzard conditions and a broken oil cooler force an emergency landing.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Over Seas
programme.desc: Buffalo has to get a CL-215 water bomber to buyers in Korea. So Justin and Cory fly the plane to Vancouver Harbour, where it will be hoisted onto a cargo ship sailing across the Pacific Ocean to its destination a method of delivery no one has ever tried.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Birthday from Hell
programme.desc: A string of bad luck turns chief pilot Arnie's 66th birthday run into the flight from hell - and threatens to spoil his naughty birthday surprise.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Friends for Life
programme.desc: A report about Robyn Davis and Carol "Sissy" Saltzman, best friends for twenty years, who were charged with murder after Robyn's husband, Brian Davis, was found shot to death alongside his car on an isolated road in St. Charles, Louisiana.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Unraveling the Lies of Jodi Arias

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Hvordan går det, når vi har allieret os med TV-værten Anders Breinholt? – det bliver lidt noget rod, og senere, så ender vi i et kæmpe dilemma, når der pludselig er flere, der springer til for at hjælpe – og vi har kun én præmie.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Denne her gang fortæller vi blandt andet om den nok mest populære video, vi har lavet – en video med Lukas Graham, der overrasker en hjælpsom fan, 10-årige Felix. Felix er SÅ sødt og hans reaktion trækker tårer hos alle der ser videoen.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi kommer omkring nogle klassiske videoer, og så prøver vi noget nyt. Vi får en bager til at give en gratis brunsviger til dem, der vælger at sætte musik på og danse i butikken – det er det sjoveste vi har lavet!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Hvad gør folk, hvis de får valget mellem at beholde en stor gave selv og give en lille en videre – eller omvendt!? Det ser vi på i de her videoer, hvor vi netop leger med at give dem, der hjælper, den mulighed. Det er overraskende, hvad der sker.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: ”Din lille luder!”, sådan bliver der blandt andet sagt i en vild video, hvor vi får en skuespiller til at sige ting, som kunder rent faktisk har sagt i virkeligheden i en kundeservice i Bilka – en video, hvor vi virkelig var nervøse under optagelsen.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Udenom og sågar henover – sådan foregår det, når folk skal passere det løbehjul, som vi har lagt på gaden midt i Århus. Det skaber stor forargelse skaber vores første virale hit. Se også hvordan det går, når vi gentager eksperimentet i Odense.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Denne her gang kommer det desværre virkelig til at handle om alle dem der IKKE hjælper. Vi kører i S-tog med en mand med sennep og ketchup i hele masken og vælter flere gange en helt tårn med toiletpapir ned i hoved på en ung pige OG ingen hjælper…

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prints Among Thieves
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected; he flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Alliance
programme.desc: When a young woman disappeared, police feared she was the latest victim in a string of similar crimes. A pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks and ordinary pine needles provided investigators with some extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cop Out
programme.desc: When a college student is found dead, evidence suggests that he knew his killer. With just three hairs and some microscopic cells, police unravel a web of lies and find the motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Summer Obsession
programme.desc: In an affluent suburb of Philadelphia, police were called to the scene of what appeared to be an accidental drowning. The investigation gradually focused on one suspect who had more than a million reasons to want the victim dead.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Elemental Clue
programme.desc: When two women from the same town were murdered in the same way, police feared a serial killer was on the loose. At first they thought the victims had nothing in common until they found tiny clues linking them to the same man.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Moss, Not Grass
programme.desc: A young woman was found dead on a golf course in the Bahamas. The grass on that course was so distinctive, it had evidentiary value. The evidence led police to two suspects, each of whom blamed the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Witness
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. But the killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Garden of Evil
programme.desc: When a popular disc jockey was found murdered in a community garden, police swung into action. A sniffer dog and a blood spatter expert led police to the killer, who had been much closer than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sunday School Ambush
programme.desc: When a man is gunned down in his own garage, investigators use science to unravel a twisted tale of lust, greed and deception.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Penchant for Poison
programme.desc: Three seemingly unrelated deaths prove to be serial murders. The killer had been careful; he used poison which had no taste or odor. Fortunately for investigators, it also had a unique chemical signature.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Family Plots
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When murder becomes a family affair, investigators must turn to forensics to uncover family plots.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blood Money
programme.desc: Some people murder for love. But these killers did it for the money. When greed is the motive, investigators must make every clue pay off.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder By Numbers
programme.desc: For serial killers, once is never enough. For investigators, the challenge is steep when the killers murder by numbers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Federal Offense
programme.desc: When there's a difficult case to crack  whether it involves drugs, arson, or weapons  the investigators and scientists of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms have the means to crack it.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Trick Or Cheaters?
programme.desc: Mandy is scared stiff about losing Jesse and regrets dumping him and Johnny's relationship with Donna is at death's door because he can't stop cheating! More spooky drama today!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I Regret You
programme.desc: Khloe is ready to reveal to Jamal that she may not be the woman he thinks she is. Nick is here to confront his wife Barbara and the man she’s been sleeping with, Jason. Plus, Danielle is ready to confront her friend Amy for spreading lies.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I'm Your Pimp, Not Your Boyfriend
programme.desc: Pimp Hotlanta will set Nika straight about their relationship. Stephanie confronts her pal Erika for having sex with her man. Gloria was crushed when she found out that her sister stole her man.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Dancing Queen Showdown
programme.desc: Carlton is here to reveal to his girlfriend that he’s leading a gay double life. Plus Tom Bergeron from TV’s ‘Dancing with The Stars’ will play celebrity judge in a dance-off. Then, Crystal reveals her infidelity to her husband Bobby.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Wet And Wild Stripper Extravaganza
programme.desc: Michael cheated on his wife Alecia with a stripper who may now be pregnant. Sarah confronts a stripper named Amy who she says slept with her man. Missy is here to lay down the laws of the strip club.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Jaw Dropping Wedding
programme.desc: Jake slept with his brother Joe’s fiancé. Then, Danny claims he’s leaving his fiancé Heather for a professional escort named Chelsi. Plus more stories of wild nuptials.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: I Will Hunt You Down
programme.desc: When two escaped inmates surface in Colorado Springs, it’s up to Lt. Joe Kenda and his Fugitive Unit to bring them to justice.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: .357 Magnum
programme.desc: The murder of a popular teen at a crowded house party sends Kenda down a winding road paved with lies, misdirection, and innuendo.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bring My Baby Home
programme.desc: A four-week-old girl is kidnapped, leaving her mother in anguish and police scrambling to find her. Joe Kenda and Robert Sapp fear she’s been sold on the black market… or worse.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Magic Bullet
programme.desc: A hard-working father of two is shot in the head just steps from a notorious strip club. The case is stuck in neutral until Kenda uncovers a conspiracy organized by an unlikely triggerman.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Too Young To Die
programme.desc: A frenzied ambush at a hamburger stand leaves a 16-year old boy dead. Lt. Joe Kenda must cut through a mountain of rumor and innuendo in order to zero in on his prime suspect.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Homicide's Elite: Sins of the Family
programme.desc: When the skull of 11-year-old Alan Watson is found in a field, Quinn and Velazquez take on the case of a murder that took place almost a decade before.

programme.title: Homicide's Elite: Deadly Affairs
programme.desc: Mother Shaquilla Weatherspoon is found murdered with her belongings scattered around her. Knowing that someone wanted it to look like a robbery, the detectives investigate those closest to Shaquilla.

programme.title: Homicide's Elite: Murder on the DL
programme.desc: When U.S. Air Force veteran John Ray is found beaten and stabbed to death in his apartment, the crime scene looks like a random robbery. But Quinn and Velazquez find it was anything but random.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: SvampeBob Firkant
programme.desc: SvampeBob Firkant, Patrick Søstjerne og alle de andre venner fra undervandsbyen Bikini Bunden er klar på masser af sjov og eventyr på kanalen, som viser den amerikanske animationsserie døgnet rundt!

programme.title: SvampeBob Firkant

programme.title: iCarly: Ude godt, men Spencer er bedst
programme.desc: Carly og Spencers bedstefar kommer på uanmeldt besøg. Han er meget bekymret for, om Spencer er for uansvarlig og skør til at være Carlys værge. Det er op til Carly og hendes venner at overbevise hendes bedstefar om, at Spencer er en ansvarlig værge.

programme.title: iCarly: Rekordforsøget
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie prøver at slå verdensrekorden i den længste, sammenhængende webcast. For at slå rekorden skal iCarly være på i mere end 24 timer i træk.

programme.title: iCarly: En date med Freddie
programme.desc: En iCarly-fan, Valerie, inviterer Freddie på en date. Daten går så godt, at Freddie begynder at filme Valeries eget webshow. Men Freddie føler sig splittet, da Valeries webshow skaber problemer for iCarly-webshowet.

programme.title: iCarly: Kunstneriske kvaler
programme.desc: Carly inviterer Spencers kunsthelt, Harry Joyner, til at kigge på Spencers kunstværker. Da Harry kalder Spencers kunst for amatøragtigt, føler Spencer, at hans liv ikke længere giver mening.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarlys største fan
programme.desc: iCarlys største fan, Mandy, inviteres til at se en livesending af iCarly. Men Mandy viser sig at være mere stalker end fan, så de må gøre alt for at slippe af med hende.

programme.title: iCarly: Rugemor
programme.desc: Carly og Sam forsøger at udklække kyllinger i et naturvidenskabsprojekt. Men æggene klækker tidligere end forventet, og pludselig er der kyllinger overalt i lejligheden! Carly, Sam, Freddie og Spencer må finde kyllingerne i lejligheden.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg gider ikke slås
programme.desc: Carly laver en en unik iCarly T-shirt til Sam for at markere årsdagen for deres venskab. Men da Sam bytter den for koncertbilletter, bliver de to venner uvenner.

programme.title: iCarly: Dansegal
programme.desc: iCarly beder sine fans om at sende videoer ind af dem dem selv, når de danser deres sejeste danse. Over tre tusind danseklip kommer ind, og Carly, Sam og Freddie prøver at holde sig vågne hele natten for at se dem.

programme.title: iCarly: Halloween-forskrækkelser
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie sender iCarly fra en lejlighed, som det siges at spøge i. Da der begynder at ske underlige ting begynder vennerne også at frygte, at spøgelsesrygterne er sande.

programme.title: iCarly: Lad der angres
programme.desc: Spencer redder livet på hovedsangeren i The Plain White T's og får ham til at deltage i iCarly. Mærkelige ting begynder at gå galt midt i Carlys, Sams og Freddies netvideosending.

programme.title: iCarly: Så er der eftersidning
programme.desc: Sam må sidde efter den aften iCarly holder sin 50. netvideosending. Carly og Freddie kan ikke gøre, som de plejer, så de prøver, så godt de kan, at få eftersidning, så de kan sende fra skolebænken med Sam.

programme.title: Apollos månerejse: Triumf og tragedie
programme.desc: Et kig på Project Gemini-missionerne, der gjorde måneopsendelsen mulig.

programme.desc: Fra Anden Verdenskrig til Den kolde krig til kampen mod ISIS, følg Amerikas færd for at bygge det perfekte stealthfly.

programme.title: Wild Baltic Sea: Between Denmark and Latvia
programme.desc: From Denmark’s northernmost corner to the endless beaches of Latvia.

programme.title: The Spying Game: War in the Shadows
programme.desc: The KGB exploits betrayal in US counterintelligence.

programme.title: Museum Secrets: Inside the State Hermitage Museum
programme.desc: From ancient mummies who sport tattoos to re-examining who really killed Rasputin, discover the secrets inside the State Hermitage Museum.

programme.title: Museum Secrets: Inside the Louvre
programme.desc: From murdered kings to stolen masterpieces, discover the secrets inside the Louvre.

programme.title: Museum Secrets: Inside the Egyptian Museum
programme.desc: From the mystery of a Pharaoh’s gold to the strange practice of animal mummification, discover the secrets inside the Egyptian Museum.

programme.title: The Mind of the Universe: The Conqueror
programme.desc: Humankind conquered the world, in order to survive, and conquers his fellow humans with new ideas. We will see how we as a species have conquered the earth, how we still compete with viruses, and how quantum theory conquers China.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: “Queer Eye’s” Karamo Brown, Beauty In A Box, Halloween Tablescapes with Darcy Miller
programme.desc: “Queer Eye’s” Karamo Brown joins Drew. In Beauty in A Box, Drew surprises a viewer at home who is need of a quick makeup routine. Plus, celebrations expert Darcy Miller shares Halloween tablescapes to help your family celebrate the holiday this year.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Anthony Anderson, Vanessa Bayer, Drew's News Emmy Eaton
programme.desc: "Black-ish" star Anthony Anderson stops by to chat. Then, "I Love This For You" star Vanessa Bayer joins Drew. Plus, budding kid journalist Emmy Eaton joins Drew and Ross Mathews at the Drew's News desk.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: "Queen of the Universe" Judges Vanessa Williams, Michelle Visage and Trixie Mattel
programme.desc: "Queen of the Universe" judges Vanessa Williams, Michelle Visage and Trixie Mattel sit down with Drew. Plus, cookbook author and star of "Mary McCartney Serves It Up," Mary McCartney shares her favorite cookie recipe.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Carrie Underwood, 7-Year-Old Raises Money For Hospital, 3 Ways To Use Pantone’s Color of the Year
programme.desc: Music superstar Carrie Underwood chats. Meet 7-year-old Hayley Orlinsky who after hearing the frontline workers were running out of PPE decided to sell homemade bracelets to raising more than $27,000. Drew shares 3 ways to use Pantone’s color of the year.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Kal Penn, Michael Urie, Eitan Bernath, Drew's News
programme.desc: "Hot Mess Holiday" star Kal Penn stops by to chat. "Single All The Way" star Michael Urie joins Drew. Plus, social media sensation Eitan Bernath wraps up cookie week sharing his favorite recipe for rugelach.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Lena Dunham, Drew's News
programme.desc: Lena Dunham on her new medieval comedy film "Catherine Called Birdy." Plus, Drew and Ross Mathews are serving the news sunny-side up in an all new Drew's News.

programme.title: On the Case: Shattered Hope
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Shelley Sikes vanishes one night after her shift, and then her abandoned, blood-streaked car is discovered on a dark roadway.

programme.title: On the Case: The Long Path to Justice
programme.desc: A couple's daily walk ends in murder and a cloud of suspicion descends on the victim's family.

programme.title: On the Case: A Father's Quest
programme.desc: After finding his beautiful 19 year old daughter dead, a father launches a relentless pursuit of her killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Cry on My Shoulder
programme.desc: When a young woman disappears, police zero in on her violent ex-boyfriend. But the secret to solving the case is buried in a cold case file.

programme.title: On the Case: Broken Trust
programme.desc: When a young girl vanishes on the way home from school, her family and police are sent on a tormenting search for answers.

programme.title: On the Case: Stolen Dreams
programme.desc: John Greathouse finds his stepdaughter, Kelli Bailey, murdered in her bedroom; investigators find a video tape and a dead man's forged check and hope these clues will be the keys to bringing Bailey's cold-blooded killer to justice.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Birthday from Hell
programme.desc: A string of bad luck turns chief pilot Arnie's 66th birthday run into the flight from hell - and threatens to spoil his naughty birthday surprise.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Power Crash
programme.desc: Cory, Chuck and Brian watch as a 5,000-pound power unit smash to the ground, denting the Electra and putting it out of commission. Mikey scrambles to manage the crisis while Joe races to England to try and purchase a backup Electra.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Frozen Four
programme.desc: As Joe fights a Transport Canada claim against the airline, star pilot Justin is tasked with shipping an 8,000lb generator to a remote town. But a controversial decision results in the DC-4 becoming stranded and frozen solid on a High Arctic airstrip.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Dark Skies
programme.desc: When Yellowknife and the northern aviation community are rocked by three crashes in the space of a month, Joe places an extra emphasis on safety, which is why he only trusts himself to perform a dangerous-looking DC-3 stunt.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Water Wings
programme.desc: In South Korea, Cory and Justin meet the ship delivering Buffalo's water bomber plane to new buyers there. But the boys are frustrated by the buyers' poor planning.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Old Dogs
programme.desc: Engine trouble plagues Buffalo's newest Electra, ZFE, and a standoff between Joe and Transport Canada threatens to close the airline. At the same time, Joe faces a tough decision about his old dog Sophie.

programme.title: 48 Hours: A Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Joanne Witt was stabbed to death while she was sleeping on Thursday, June 11, 2009. One month prior to her death Joanne found her 14-year-old daughter Tylar Witt in a compromising situation with 19-year-old Stephen Colver.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Hunt for Mr. Wright
programme.desc: A report on George Wright, who was sentenced to prison for the 1962 murder of New Jersey service station owner Walter Patterson, and who after spending 8 years in prison, escaped, and spent 40 years on the run from the authorities.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Shattered Dreams
programme.desc: 48 Hours is television's most popular true-crime series, investigating shocking cases and compelling real-life dramas with journalistic integrity and cutting-edge style.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Chasing the Barefoot Bandit
programme.desc: A report on Colton Harris-Moore, also known as the “Barefoot Bandit,” because of his habit of committing crimes barefoot and leaving chalk outlines of his feet; and whose exploits included stealing planes, guns, yachts, and escaping to foreign countries.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Secrets, Lies and Alibis
programme.desc: John and Susan Sutton were sleeping in separate rooms in their Florida home, when a gunman entered their house and shot both of them several times. Susan was killed, but John survived. Nothing was taken from the house, proving the murder premeditated.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Long Island Serial Killer
programme.desc: A report on the disappearance of Shannan Gilbert, near Gilgo Beach, New York. The search for Shannan led to the discovery of a total of ten bodies in the scrub brush of Gilgo Beach, leading police to suspect the work of a serial killer.

programme.title: COPS: Crash Landing
programme.desc: Police have a breakthrough in a burglary case, a man found with drugs in his pants claims the pants are not his, and officers deal with a familiar domestic disturbance call.

programme.title: COPS: The One Dollar Shoe
programme.desc: Officers wrestle with a familiar nuisance to shop owners, a man's lucky dollar lets him down during a traffic stop, and too much whiskey leads to a domestic disturbance call.

programme.title: COPS: Getting Funcky
programme.desc: A cyclist takes flight, police find a woman at the wheel of a stolen truck, and officers roll up on a couple smoking meth while their four-year-old is in the car with them.

programme.title: COPS: Hit and Run
programme.desc: The threat of a tasing is enough to slow a fleeing suspect, a heated argument between girlfriends leads to vehicular assault, and a man with weed in his car has no poker face.

programme.title: COPS: Be Careful What You Ask For
programme.desc: An unstable man in a standoff with officers begs to be shot, a drunk woman is accused of beating her spouse, and unwanted guests occupy the garage of an out-of-town homeowner.

programme.title: COPS: Cats and Dogs
programme.desc: A trespassing man uses his dog as a shield when police arrive at the scene, a stolen tablet leads to a bloody altercation, and kittens run wild in a Florida neighborhood.

programme.title: COPS: Sittin' in the Dark
programme.desc: A suspect seen fleeing a vehicle refuses to admit he was ever in said vehicle, and police respond to a call that shots were fired.

programme.title: COPS: The Blame Game
programme.desc: An arrested man has a long list of instructions for his "bae," and a driver charged with heroin possession claims he was framed by the passenger in his backseat.

programme.title: COPS: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: A recently released convict leads police on a high-speed chase in a stolen vehicle, and officers respond to a report of a man pulling a knife on his brother.

programme.title: COPS: That's My Grill
programme.desc: A son fights his mom and responding officers, a man tells police the wad of weed in his mouth is not his, and a pack of cigarillos is the root of a domestic dispute.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Disappeared Of Nancy: The Julie Martin Affair
programme.desc: On June 30, 2014, in Nancy, the police are called to the home of Julie Martin, a 34-year-old nurse.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: The Last Tango (Saada case)
programme.desc: The lifeless, mutilated body of a woman is found in the Rambouillet Forest.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Strange Farm: The Anaïs Guillaume Affair
programme.desc: On the night of April 16, 2013, Anaïs Guillaume, 21, mysteriously disappears in Fromy (Ardennes) after spending the evening at her companion's farm.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Strange Deadly Robbery: The Isabelle Mosser Case
programme.desc: On September 12, 2013, Eric Mosser, a 45-year-old heating engineer, discovers his wife Isabelle lying in a pool of blood at their home in Illfurth, Alsace.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Mysterious Disappearences in Paris - Christelle Leroy
programme.desc: On March 21th 1991, Pascale Escarfail, 19 years old, is discovered dead at her studio in the 14th arrondissement of Paris, she was raped then stabbed multiple times.

programme.title: Aliens Among Us: The Michael Wolf Theory
programme.desc: Michael K. Wolf deler 30 års indsigt i ufoer, rumvæsner, regeringsprojekter og korncirkler. Dette program vises uden undertekster.

programme.desc: I dag er Spørgekassen byttet ud med SVEDEkassen, når radio- og TV-vært Sara Bro tager Anders med ind i varmen. Men før det bliver rigtig hot, kigger de lidt på insta-rullen fra Saras 50 års fødselsdag – som i øvrigt også er brandvarm

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 116

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 117
programme.desc: Thor om en vild koncert, han holdt for nylig. Men er dagens gæst i virkeligheden gabende kedelig – eller er han en rigtig jetsetter? Og hvad ville han redde, hvis hans lejlighed stod i brand?

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 118
programme.desc: NU bliver det vildt! Den legendariske trommeslager fra Metallica er i Danmark, så han tager på roadtrip med Anders. De to gamle venner snakker fortroligt om både kunst, barndommen i whiskeybæltet og en nylig sorg i Lars´s liv.

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 119
programme.desc: Nygifte Tine Gøtzsche besøger Breinholts på Magneten og bliver fejret efter alle kunstens – og kærlighedens – regler. Hør om det mildest talt utraditionelle bryllup og se med, da Tine vandt prisen som “Årets Hotteste”.

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 120
programme.desc: For at fejre én af Fyns fineste ambassadører Hjalmer Larsen bliver der serveret brunssviger, spillet helt ny musik og snakket om kærestens begejstring over Hjalmers overskæg. Og så får vi fornøjelsen af Hjalmers bare røv!

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Hitler's Biggest Blunder
programme.desc: Hitler rules Europe triumphantly, hailed as a hero in Germany. Hitler invades the Soviet Union, promising swift victory over communism, but progress stalls. As Germany faces setbacks, Hitler retreats to his bunker in Poland, increasingly reliant on drugs.

programme.title: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster
programme.desc: Operation North Pole was a WWII German deception using captured SOE agents to mislead Britain. 47 of 50 agents were captured. Despite warnings, SOE ignored signs of compromise to maintain support, leading to a major intelligence failure.

programme.title: Secret War: The SAS Italian Job
programme.desc: In 1945, during the Italian Spring offensive, SOE agent Michael Lees and SAS officer Roy Farran led a raid on German HQs at Villa Rossi and Villa Calvi. Despite orders to cancel, Farran attacked with SAS men and partisans, killing many Germans.

programme.title: Secret War: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco
programme.desc: After WWII, SOE disbanded, leaving Vera Atkins to uncover fates of 118 agents, including 13 women. Many were betrayed and sent to camps; some were executed. Atkins' quest continued, marked by personal impact and delayed recognition.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Overlord
programme.desc: After a careful campaign of disinformation that throws the German defenders off-guard, the Western Allies finally land on Normandy.France is liberated.

programme.title: Awkward: Best Friends For Never
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at gøre Idea Bin til et hyggeligere sted for hende selv, skaffer Jenna en praktikplads til Tamara, men opdager hurtigt, det kan være katastrofalt at arbejde med venner.

programme.title: Awkward: Fireworks
programme.desc: Jake giver Jenna og Tamara vagter i country-klubben den 4. juli, men Sullys planer om en efterfest på golfbanen resulterer i et dramatisk fyrværkeri.

programme.title: Awkward: Digging Deep
programme.desc: Efter en sjov 4. juli, fortsætter Jenna og Matty med at fyre op under venskabet ved at holde fest for Jake - i det mindste indtil Jennas nyeste Idea Bin-post truer med at afsløre alt.

programme.title: Awkward: Girls Gone Viral
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at vælge mellem succes hos Idea Bin og sit venskab med Matty. Jake oplever et uventet intimt møde, og Sadie og Sergio afslører pludselig mere end nogensinde før.

programme.title: Awkward: Misadventures in Babysitting
programme.desc: Jenna melder sig som barnepige og modtager uventet hjælp af Matty. Imens får Lissa at vide, hvad der er hemmeligheden ved at være en Palos Hills-mor, og Tamara og Sadie får mere end nok til en rig teenagers strandfest.

programme.title: Awkward: Living in Sin
programme.desc: Jenna tager forholdet med Luke et nyt niveau og Tamaras gæld kommer tilbage og bider hende i halen.

programme.title: Awkward: Home Again, Home Again
programme.desc: Et skænderi med Luke presser Jenna til at tage med til lejrgenforeningen og dermed mod at genoptage kontakten med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Second Chances
programme.desc: Luke hjælper Jenna med at få et vigtigt møde på SCU, Tamara er ærlig over for Patrick om sine pengeproblemer, og Matty får Sadies hjælp til at komme ind i varmen igen hos Lacey.

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails
programme.desc: Jenna må vælge mellem et vigtigt SCU-event og lejrgenforeningen, noget der fører til et endnu større valg: Luke eller Matty. Men hun er ikke alene, for både Jake, Tamara og Lissa må også tage afgørende valg.

programme.title: Awkward: Pilot
programme.desc: Det går fra slemt til rigtig slemt for Jenna Hamilton, når et mystisk brev får alle til at tro, at hun har forsøgt at begå selvmord. Jenna foretager nogle store ændringer i sit liv snarere end at lade sin nye identitet definere hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Knocker Nightmare
programme.desc: Sadie og Lissa sms'er et nøgenfoto af Jenna i pigernes omklædningsrum til hele skolen. Ud over latterliggørelse og sladder får spøgen nogle overraskende reaktioner fra Jennas store forelskelse Matty.

programme.title: South Park: Trapper Keeper
programme.desc: Cartman har fået en ny Trapper Keeper. Da han har pralet af den, fortæller en fremmed ham, at den snart vil overtage verden, hvis de ikke destruerer den nu.

programme.title: South Park: Cupid Ye
programme.desc: Cartman er jaloux på venskabet mellem Kyle og Tolkien og beslutter at gøre noget ved sagen.

programme.title: South Park: F-ordet

programme.title: South Park: Surt for Cartman

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Det er blevet tid til Mr. Paradise, og drengene skal på photo shoot. Imens er der dømt tøsehygge på hotellet, hvor der bliver hygget og snakket om drenge. Men et brev ændrer stemningen fuldstændig.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Der er fest, og stemningen til aften er lummer. Pludselig smutter nogle gæsterne ned på et værelse for at hygge sig. Efterfølgende skal der lyves for at holde på hemmeligheden.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Det er blevet tid til Mr. Paradise finale, og drengene er helt oppe og køre over at skulle lave et fedt show for pigerne. En ekstra opgave udfordrer drengenes romatiske evner.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Vil en personlig relation kunne redde én af gæsterne fra at blive smidt hjem til aftenens Parceremoni? Og så får aftenen en noget anderledes og uhyggelige afslutning, end hvad gæsterne er vant til.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Hotellets gæster får sig en ubehagelig nat, da en uhyggelig dukke vandrer rundt på Paradise Hotel. En gammel kending vender tilbage, men det er bestemt ikke alle, der er lige begejstrede for gensynet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Én af drengene sætter en anden dreng i fare, og det udløser vrede og skuffelse. Og så får én af pigerne en viden, der overrasker hende meget, og det udløser et skænderi mellem to allierede.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 2303
programme.desc: I Horsens drømmer 33-årige Ravna og 39-årige Eric om at købe et hus sammen. Men Erics store skattegæld spænder ben for drømmen og banken vil ikke låne dem penge, før gælden er væk.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 2304
programme.desc: 42-årige Kenneth fra Korsør faldt pludseligt om på sit arbejde. Lægerne troede det var en blodprop, men det viste sig at være stress. Stress over at han i 12 år har ignoreret sin gæld.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 2305
programme.desc: 34-årige Lene fra Vojens bor hos sin kæreste Thomas. Med sig har hun en gæld på over 400.000 kroner, som stammer fra hendes fortid med ekskæresten, hvor de brugte de fleste af deres penge på hash.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 2306
programme.desc: Mikkel er asfaltørelev, så når han ikke er i skole, bor han hos sin kæreste, Steffanie. Men Mikkel betaler ikke husleje, så Steffanie står med hele regningen.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 2307
programme.desc: Morten ”gejler” sine biler og på blot fire år har han ejet 12 biler. Det har efterladt ham med en gæld på næsten 300.000, som han har svært ved at betale.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 2308
programme.desc: 31-årige Jeanette er for nylig blevet mor til en lille pige. Jeanette har tidligere taget mange stoffer og knust en stribe butiksruder. Hun er ude af sit misbrug, men gælden fra hærværket hænger ved.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi ved godt, at det er tarveligt at bruge små søde børn, der har brug for hjælp. Det er nemlig et billigt trick, MEN det virker. Og en ting er, at set up’et er sødt, men ham der hjælpers reaktion er virkelig også skøn – det er jul, når det er bedst!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.desc: Miguel og Sarah er nygifte og fuldstændig forelskede i hinanden, men de slås med at opdyrke deres lille jordstykke i New Mexico. Men der venter en langt større kamp, for den magtsyge jordejer og byens prædikant Josia vil have fingrene i deres ejendom.

programme.desc: Brad har en udmærket karriere og lever et komfortabelt liv sammen med sin hustru og søn, men hans gamle venners liv virker mere glamourøst og rigt. Da han genoptager kontakten med dem, kommer han dog til at tvivle på, hvem der lever det gode liv.

programme.title: Love Island UK

programme.title: Love Island UK

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Little-Ton Jones
programme.desc: Allen & Ton try to get the inside scoop on their competition by chatting up local auction buyers. The guys find some heavy gold-mining machinery from the 1950s & an amateur rocket that can travel faster than the speed of sound!

programme.desc: Rare 1950s Master Pitch baseball machine; 1980s Jaws of Life tool used by rescuers to pry open cars.

programme.desc: Ton and Allen invade the Nation's capital, but meet strong resistance from local bidders. The guys uncover a Civil War era black powder revolver and a stash of South African gold coins!

programme.desc: Allen & Ton visit Ton's old stompin' ground and go head-to-head with a trash-talking auction buyer. They uncover a 19th century rifle with a matching cutlass bayonet and a mechanical bowling pinsetter from the early 1960's!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Night of the Digging Dead
programme.desc: A custom-built shark cage; 1900s pathologist's dissection toolkit; 1940s embalming pump and one of the first electric bone saws.

programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes on the attack & ends up on a collision course with a hardened veteran auction buyer. They uncover a collection of speedy off-road vehicles and some hardcore heavy metal from the turn-of the-century!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Miami Heat
programme.desc: All-terrain Air Commander Hovercraft, a 1970s NASA countdown clock and a one-of-a-kind 1960s Delta Relay rocket.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Weapons of Past Destruction
programme.desc: Knowing that Hollywood auctions are hit-and-miss, Allen and Ton buy inexpensive lockers that contain a polygraph machine, a samurai sword and a pair of Civil War shotguns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Early Bird Special
programme.desc: Vintage Shooting Star carnival game; professional Mixed Martial Arts octagon fighting cage.

programme.desc: Allen & Ton head to New Orleans in search of easy money, but instead encounter some bayou bidders with big-time bucks! They discover a pair of early 19th-century dueling pistols & a vintage airboat fitted with a turbine engine!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Voodoo Moola

programme.title: The Hills: When One Door Closes...
programme.desc: Lauren får en god nyhed til Teen Vogue og Heidi har brug for noget tid væk fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: Paris Changes Everything
programme.desc: Lauren kommer endelig af sted til Paris, men turen bliver næsten ødelagt da hun finder ud af, at Brody har fundet en anden. Spencer følger Heidi til Colorado for at prøve at vinde hende tilbage, men hans plan slår fejl.

programme.title: The Hills: Back to L.A.
programme.desc: Whitney må vælge mellem Teen Vogue og risikoen forbundet med at gå efter en ny karriere. Lauren og Brody skændes over hans nye kæreste og Heidi vænner sig til livet uden Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Friend
programme.desc: Lauren får en uventet ven, da Spencers søster, Stephanie, går til de samme timer som hende. Whitney tror, at hendes nye job vil opfylde alle hendes drømme.

programme.title: The Hills: When Spencer Finds Out...
programme.desc: Da Lauren inviterer Stephanie til hendes fødselsdag, får det Heidi og Spencer til at tvivle på Stephanies loyalitet. Spencer forsøger at vinde Heidi tilbage.

programme.title: The Hills: Just Be Careful...
programme.desc: Heidi prøver at vinde Audrinas venskab tilbage, men Lauren tvivler på Heidis motiver. Whitney er ved at vænne sig til sit nye job, men savner stadig at arbejde sammen med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Girls' Night Out
programme.desc: Heidi elsker at være single, men da hun ser Spencer sammen med andre piger bliver hun jaloux. Whitney beder om Laurens hjælp til modeugen i LA.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Roommate
programme.desc: Med Spencer ude af billedet, gør Heidi et sidste forsøg på at blive gode venner med Lauren igen. Da Audrina begynder at tilbringe mere tid med Heidi og Justin, overvejer Lauren, om de bør blive ved med at bo sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: A Date With The Past
programme.desc: Gammel kærlighed blusser op da Stephen Coletti dukker op i Laurens liv igen. Heidi prøver at sørge for, at Stephanie ikke kommer til Laurens housewarming.

programme.title: The Hills: No Place Like Home
programme.desc: Lauren har svært ved at vælge side, da problemerne mellem Lo og Audrina eskalerer. Og Heidi tager et job, der vil tage hende til Las Vegas.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion Part 1
programme.desc: Efter en turbulent sæson genforenes singlerne og ekserne for første gang for at tale om sæsonens største forhold, splittelser og forræderi. De afslører, om de stadig er forelskede eller er gået fra hinanden siden sæsonen sluttede.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion Part 2
programme.desc: Dramaet fortsætter i anden del af Ex on the Beach Reunion, da løgnedetektoren tvinger Morgan til at indrømme sandheden, et nyt forhold afsløres og utroskab afdækkes.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Welcome to the Peak
programme.desc: 10 reality-kendisser tager til et vinterlandskab for at se, om de kan finde deres næste udkårne, men de ved ikke, at deres ekser vil komme stormende som en lavine.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Winter Un-Wonderland
programme.desc: Callum og Nicoles ekser skaber store problemer. En forbindelse bliver skabt og hurtigt brudt igen. En ny eks kommer, og den første hotte date bliver belønnet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Caught Red Velvet Handed
programme.desc: Daniel gør et akavet forsøg på at skabe en forbindelse. Det går hedt for sig i Hemmelighedssaunaen for en lumsk single. Den første eks bliver frosset ude.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: De Niall Is Not Just an Ex
programme.desc: Marlon får opmærksomhed fra flere ekser, og det er Adore ikke glad for. En charmerende overraskelse afbryder den hotte date.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride
programme.desc: I dette afsnit pimper teamet Kerrys Ford Escort. Bilen består af to halvdele af to forskellige Ford Escorts, der er blevet svejset og "klistret" sammen. Teamet mener, den er for farlig at køre rundt i...

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1984 Cadillac Eldorado
programme.desc: Xzibit takes a beat-up 1984 Cadillac Eldorado and restores it to it's former glory.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1991 Ford Escort
programme.desc: In this episode, Xzibit and the boys at West Coast Customs transform a '91 Ford Escort into a European luxury mobile.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1958 VW Bus
programme.desc: In this episode, Xzibit and West Coast Customs give a 1958 VW some California love, and turn it into the ultimate beach ride.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1985 Suburban
programme.desc: In this episode, Xzibit takes a busted off-road '85 Suburban and gives it an electronic makeover not to be believed.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1987 Chevrolet Blazer
programme.desc: In this episode, Xzibit puts the fire back into a wrecked '87 Chevy Blazer.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1988 Acura Legend
programme.desc: In this episode, Xzibit and West Coast Customs help a 1988 Acura Legend live up to its name.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 2005 Toyota 4Runner
programme.desc: When Xzibit rolls on into the garage with the Fairlane, the boys can't believe their eyes. So they decide to give West his Fairlane back to tinker with and get him a brand-new pimped Toyota 4Runner.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1985 Ford Econoline Van
programme.desc: Xzibit and the boys at West Coast pimp Nate's Ford Econoline.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1988 Chevy S-10
programme.desc: In this episode, West Coast Customs pimps Sara's Chevrolet S-10.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1991 Cavalier Convertible
programme.desc: In this episode, West Coast Customs pimps Brooke's Chevrolet Cavalier Convertible.

programme.title: Are You The One?: There Was A Fivesome?
programme.desc: En femkant får dynamikken i huset til at smuldre. Justins selvdestruktive tendenser truer hans forhold til Max. Danny skaber kontakt.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Hate to Burst Your Bubble
programme.desc: Huset vil finde ud af, hvilke af parrene er et perfekt match. Jonathan vil knalde en kærlighedsboble. Kai stiller sig foran Jenna.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Red Flag Alert
programme.desc: Jonathan forsøger at gøre det godt igen med Basit. Et par kommer tættere på hinanden mens andre forsøger at ændre på deres giftige datingadfærd.

programme.title: Are You The One?: This Sucks and Blows
programme.desc: Venner og familie sætter fut i huset. Jenna forsøger at navigere strategi i forhold til hjerte. En tur i bolleværelset har eksplosive konsekvenser.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Games Players Play
programme.desc: De andre i huset må samle stykkerne op da Kais opførsel lægger alt i ruiner. Remy forsøger at lægge sin player-fortid bag sig for at overbevise Paige.

programme.title: Are You The One?: It All Comes Down to Jax
programme.desc: Tre par finder ud af, at de er et perfekt match og to par får en dårlig nyhed. Justin og Max får svar. Paige har svært ved at sænke paraderne.

programme.title: Are You The One?: On to the Next
programme.desc: De sidste tre par skal vælges, og en person ved, hvem deres match er. De nye perfekte match lærer hinanden bedre at kende.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 204
programme.desc: I Kragerøs fantastiske skærgård skal Halvor og drengene forvandle et gammelt bådehus samt udearealet til et sommerparadis med smarte og kreative løsninger i ægte Hamptons-stil.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 205
programme.desc: En hytte på Lifjell i Telemark har stået uberørt et halvt århundrede og er et vidunderligt udgangspunkt for Halvor og teamet, som sætter sig for at modernisere bygningen for dens nye ejere.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 206
programme.desc: Denne gang skal Halvor og gutterne give en familiehytte med en smuk udsigt over Gudbrandsdalen nye og praktiske løsninger.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 207
programme.desc: Halvor tager teamet med til den barske Trøndelag-kyst for at arbejde på en gammel butik. Stilfuld, minimalistisk renovering er i fokus, og Ole og Gustav tager en uforglemmelig tur på havet!

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 208
programme.desc: Med inspiration fra Aspen, Colorado, renoverer Halvor og drengene en hytte i bjergene over Hallingdal. Cowboy-Ole laver en fantastisk lampe af noget 7500 år gammelt egetræ!

programme.desc: De sidste otte audition-vindere skal bestå en kartoffel-skillstest. Derefter fortsætter dagen i par, hvor det rigtige makker-valg kan redde dem fra eliminering.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: Dommerne præsenterer moules som dagens udfordring. Deltagerne skal kopiere retten præcist for at undgå endnu en hård runde i havets specialiteter.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: Emil Nakahara lærer deltagerne at bruge tofu. Derefter dyster parrene, og vinderne mødes i en duel om en værdifuld fordel.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: Vinderparret mødes i en kniv-skills duel med appelsinfiletering. Deltagerne kommer ligeledes på en svær opgave, når de skal træffe vigtige valg – i blinde.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: Alt er vendt på hovedet i år, og dommerne har et ekstra es i ærmet. Syv tidligere deltagere vender tilbage for at få en ny chance. Twistet ryster alt og sætter årets madaspiranter under massivt pres.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: Ciao bella! Det italienske køkken kalder. Deltagerne skal lave en hofret med en rislignende pastatype. Bagefter venter et kæmpe bord af lækre italienske råvarer.

programme.desc: Selvom man bor småt, kan man godt invitere til middagsselskab. Det beviser radio- og tv-vært Helin Erdem, når hun inviterer sine gæster med til sit elskede Albertslund.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1315

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1316
programme.desc: Politikeren Sikandar Siddique byder sine gæster indenfor til en oplevelse, der giver gæsterne et indblik i sin baggrund, og vi er med når Sikandar åbner op om en yderst svær periode i sit liv.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1301
programme.desc: Realitystjernen Gustav Salinas byder indenfor i sin eksklusive lejlighed. Værten byder på mad fra varme lande, og lukker sine farvestrålende gæster indenfor i sit svære kærlighedsliv.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1302
programme.desc: Jackie Navarro er en af Danmarks største tv-personligheder og influencere, og i aften byder hun indenfor i sin villa nord for København. Snakken går, når Jackie åbner op om både kærlighed og had.
