programme.desc: I et nyt afsnit af Ridiculousness fejrer Rob, Chanel og Steelo ældre mennesker i 'Den mest liderlige generation', tjekker nogle børn ud, der ville have det 'Bedre uden forældre' og ser, hvordan man giver 'Ekstra 10 procent'.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: Amber og Gary løser omsider deres myndighedstvist om Leah. Farrah planlægger at flytte til LA, men er usikker på sit forhold til Simon. Catelynn og Tyler overvejer at få et barn mere, og mødrene rejser til LA.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: Farrahs mor konfronterer Simon til Sophias 7-års fødselsdag. Amber håndterer det seneste medierygte om Matt. Catelynns depression kommer tilbage, og hun søger hjælp hos dr. Drew.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: Maci og Taylor opdager, at den uventede graviditet er mere fremskreden, end de troede. Matt tager Amber med til sin hjemby, hvor hun møder hans familiemedlemmer.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 401
programme.desc: Boligkøb i blinde er tilbage, og i sæsonpremieren møder vi Tine og Lars, som har svimlende otte millioner at købe hus og renovere for. Det store budget har dog ikke hjulpet dem hidtil – kan eksperterne?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 402
programme.desc: Boligkøb i blindes eksperter kommer på arbejde i Hørning, hvor præsten og hendes familie bor til leje i et rækkehus og gerne vil videre – men bliver skræmte af tilstandsrapporter og spidse tage.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 404
programme.desc: Ida og Rasmus drømmer om at skifte deres 60 kvm lejebolig på Nørrebro ud med en murermestervilla i Hillerød. Men de fortryder bittert, at de lod eksperterne hjælpe, da de ser det hus, pengene rakte til.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 405
programme.desc: Anna Thora og Jonas har to små børn – og en drøm om at flytte sammen med bedsteforældrene. Så eksperterne skal på jagt efter et hus, der kan rumme to familier, med plads til alle og deres behov.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 606
programme.desc: Tunø er med sine blot 118 beboere og en sparsom færgeforbindelse til fastlandet en del af det udkantsdanmark, som kan være svært at holde liv i. Det vil Jan og Christina fra Thunø Kro gøre noget ved.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 701
programme.desc: Carsten driver restaurant Karin’s Hjemmelavede i Næstved. Men jobbet som restauratør, er dog noget uvant for den tidligere VVS’er, der ingen erfaring har på området.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 702
programme.desc: I Vejle er stemningen på nulpunktet. Heini og Marianas drøm om et argentinsk spisehus er begyndt at briste. Heini er nedlagt med sygdom, og Mariana kan ikke klare arbejdet i restauranten selv.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 703
programme.desc: Caféen i Aalborg kører slet ikke rundt. En forretning udelukkende baseret på billige deal-gæster, truer med at slå bunden ud af det unge forpagter-pars økonomi.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 704
programme.desc: På Da Carmine har de en vaskeægte napolitansk kok! Men problemet er bare, at han har mistet passionen for at lave ægte italiensk mad.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 705
programme.desc: I de smukkeste omgivelser i Korsør lystskov ligger restaurant Sommerlyst. Stedet er drevet af Jesper og Yvonne, der 4 måneder inde i deres forpagtning, allerede er ved at kaste håndklædet i ringen.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Sleeping with the Enemy
programme.desc: Stemningen i huset er yderst trykket efter pigernes infight og et meget overraskende hook-up chokerer crewet.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: All in the Family
programme.desc: Vinnys onkel Nino kommer på besøg og føler sig straks hjemme. The Situation fortæller Jose at Angelina var sammen med Vinny bag hans ryg.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Dirty Pad
programme.desc: Angelina fortsætter med at komme i clinch med de andre i huset og The Situation får endelig sin hævn foran hendes venner.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Gone, Baby, Gone
programme.desc: The Situation bliver genforenet med sin Canadiske skønhed, og det underholder resten af huset. Og så fortæller Angelina endelig sandheden om hvad hun mener om sine roomies i Jersey Shore huset, hvilket får Snooki til at se rødt.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Girls Like That
programme.desc: Vinny vælger mellem to piger. Snooki synes at det er på tide, nu når Angelina ikke er i huset længere, at hende og JWOWW begraver stridsøksen med Sammi. Men Snookis lykke er kortvarig, da The Situation er på krigsstien.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Deja Vu All Over Again
programme.desc: Alle er utilfredse med The Situation fordi han ikke er som han plejer - han får roomierne smidt ud fra en natklub, brænder næsten huset ned og viser sig at være en dårlig wingman for Pauly D to gange!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: It All Kicks Off
programme.desc: Husets mure i Geordie Shore ryster, da Charlotte og Holly ender i et kæmpestort skænderi med den nye pige Marnie på en natklub, og det går helt skævt.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Det ulmer i luften, når Marnie kommer tilbage til huset efter skænderiet på natklubben med Holly og Charlotte. Pigerne kan ikke tåle, at Marnie kommer tilbage, og fyrene går i chok, når en ondskabsfuld kamp bryder ud igen.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: So Much For Family Night
programme.desc: Den vilde sommer når et klimaks, når Geordie-slænget fortsat drikker sig stive og scorer. Et sidste dramatisk udbrud efterlater huset i choktilstand. Gary og Holly er sure på Charlottes kæreste over, hvordan han behandler hende.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Gaz's Birthday
programme.desc: Geordie-slænget er tilbage i byen til mere fest, flirt og druk. Alle glæder sig til at møde den nye fyr Aaron, og Marnie lover at holde sig væk fra alle fyre men går i seng med Gaz den første aften.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Lad Code
programme.desc: Gary bliver jaloux da Marnie flirter med den nye fyr Aaron. Alle bliver sure, da Vicky kommer tilbage til huset, og den første 'Tash-On'-tur er en realitet da slænget tanker op med tequila på single-aftenen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Time To Get Serious
programme.desc: Kandidaterne starter deres sjette uge, og de må begynde at se ud som DCC, eller også kan de risikere at miste deres pladser. Melissa Rycroft og tidligere DCC Tina Kalina vikarierer for Judy og Kelli for at se kandidaterne med nye øjne.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: A Lucid Dream
programme.desc: Der er tre piger tilbage at sende hjem, og den første kamp er lige rundt om hjørnet, så presset er enormt, når pigerne vender tilbage til AT&T Stadium for at indtage banen for første gang siden udtagelserne.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: The Payoff
programme.desc: Det er træningslejrens sidste dag, og alle er nervøse for, at Kelli og Judy skal udvælge en trup med færre end 36 medlemmer. Efter nogle hårde beslutninger forvandles skræk til glæde, da truppen bekendtgøres.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Dare To Dream
programme.desc: Denne sæson har 400 piger turde drømme stort. De vil blive en af de verdensberømte Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders. De satser alt, når de indledende udtagelser til truppen 2015-2016 begynder.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Dance Your Heart Out
programme.desc: 23 veteraner melder sig til udtagelserne for at konkurrere mod 59 nybegyndere, som vil tage deres pladser. Talent og udseende er ikke nok til en plads i truppen. Drømme går både i opfyldelse og bliver knust, da 46 kommer med på lejren.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: An Emotional Beginning

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark

programme.title: Forensic Files: Penchant for Poison
programme.desc: Three seemingly unrelated deaths prove to be serial murders. The killer had been careful; he used poison which had no taste or odor. Fortunately for investigators, it also had a unique chemical signature.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bump in the Night
programme.desc: When a victim is brutally murdered in his own bed, investigators find a shoe impression in the mud outside — physical evidence they hope will lead to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sole Searching
programme.desc: Armed with little else, police hoped that shoe impressions found at a Lansing, Michigan crime scene would put their investigation of Audrey Nichols' murder back on track.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder on the Menu
programme.desc: When the head chef of a historic Philadelphia restaurant was found dead, investigators interviewed the usual suspects: family, friends and coworkers. As they sifted through the evidence, police uncovered a chilling tale of debt and deceit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hot on the Trail
programme.desc: When Washington, DC is plagued by a series of arson fires — each started with the same type of incendiary device — it's up to forensic scientists to find the clues that lay in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: High 'n Dry
programme.desc: When Genell Plude is found dead in her bathroom, the scene points to suicide. But a coroner's inquest and a unique application of forensic science give investigators a different explanation for her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: To the Viktor
programme.desc: Faced with three homicides that appear to be professional executions, investigators on both sides of the Atlantic must find a common thread between the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wired for Disaster
programme.desc: Faced with three homicides that appear to be professional executions, investigators on both sides of the Atlantic must find a common thread between the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wood-be Killer
programme.desc: A killer tries to incinerate everything that could link him to his crime. But in doing so, he inadvertently creates new forensic evidence. Detectives employ a technique never before used in a criminal investigation to bring it to light.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naughty or Nyce
programme.desc: A woman appears to have lost control of her SUV and plunged down an embankment into a shallow creek. But investigators suspect foul play when they find snowy footprints leading away from the crime scene.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Federal Offense
programme.desc: When there's a difficult case to crack  whether it involves drugs, arson, or weapons  the investigators and scientists of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms have the means to crack it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Flames Of Justice
programme.desc: Arson fires are set for their own sake, or to cover a different crime, such as murder. Think fire consumes all vital clues? Think again. Arson investigators can glean important clues from scorched rubble and ignite the unquenchable flames of justice.

programme.title: The New Detectives: False Witness
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Missing
programme.desc: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Some are runaways who find their way home, but others simply disappear. When foul play is suspected, investigators turn to forensics to find the missing.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Last Fare
programme.desc: A young man is found dead behind the wheel of his taxi. With robbery seeming unlikely, Kenda and Gaenzle wonder if this was personal.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: En af de bedste gerninger, man kan gøre, er at sige noget pænt til en fremmed. Det er vi ikke så gode til her i landet, derfor lader vi selvfølgelig en mand gøre det. Det er SÅ fedt, dejligt og tankevækkende at se folks reaktioner på de søde ord.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Hvordan går det, når vi har allieret os med TV-værten Anders Breinholt? – det bliver lidt noget rod, og senere, så ender vi i et kæmpe dilemma, når der pludselig er flere, der springer til for at hjælpe – og vi har kun én præmie.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Denne her gang fortæller vi blandt andet om den nok mest populære video, vi har lavet – en video med Lukas Graham, der overrasker en hjælpsom fan, 10-årige Felix. Felix er SÅ sødt og hans reaktion trækker tårer hos alle der ser videoen.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi kommer omkring nogle klassiske videoer, og så prøver vi noget nyt. Vi får en bager til at give en gratis brunsviger til dem, der vælger at sætte musik på og danse i butikken – det er det sjoveste vi har lavet!

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland

programme.title: Forensic Files: Just Desserts

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sunday's Wake

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 7: The Milky Way

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun
